id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a schema discovery catalog scan that hits statement timeout

review.posthog_relevance: Database warehouse ingestion and schema discovery workflow
review.reason: Adds a dedicated non-retryable exception and classification for database catalog scan timeouts, preventing futile workflow retries when the warehouse metadata discovery exceeds statement limits.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation of the exception and classification; however, the actual execution path and complete workflow changes are not present in this chunk, so the end-to-end behavior and complete validation are not demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the retry-avoidance wrapper around the catalog scan, nor the activity-layer configuration, nor the complete workflow changes. It only shows the error factory, the exception classification, and tests. Without seeing the actual execution path and the complete workflow, the tier cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Adds a factory function to construct a non-retryable QueryTimeoutException with a message indicating the catalog scan timed out.
observations.code_quote: "Timed out listing table columns while discovering the database schema. There are enough "
observations.posthog_connection: This exception is raised when the database catalog scan exceeds the statement timeout, distinguishing it from transient recovery conflicts. It prevents the workflow from retrying the same futile scan.

observations.behavior: Wraps the catalog scan query in a try/except to distinguish statement-timeout from recovery conflicts.
observations.code_quote: if "statement timeout" not in " ".join(str(arg) for arg in e.args).lower():
observations.posthog_connection: This check prevents the workflow from retrying a genuine statement-timeout, while still allowing recovery conflicts to propagate for the outer retry loop.
